title: gilia multicaulis var. peduncularis
intro: Gilia multicaulis var. peduncularis, commonly known as Western gilia, is a plant species in the family Polemoniaceae. It is a perennial herb that has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. Western gilia has been reported to have anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation, prevent infections, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Western gilia include glycosides, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
